sources.snippet: One of my papers, Caging in Time, has recently been accepted by International Journal of Robotics Research (IJRR). I built XLeRobot as a personal hobby to instantiate my research theory, also to provide a low-cost platform for people who are interested in robotics and embodied AI to work with.

sources.snippet: 🛒 Base movement precision may be affected by the IKEA cart wheels—this can be addressed through closed-loop feedback control All things considered—cost, community support, ease of assembly, and practical utility—XLeRobot stands out as one of the most compelling low-cost robot for indoor application!
